values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/cusinolake ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Cusino Lake State Forest Campground: 6 sites, $20), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Carry-in boat access at each campsite; no boat ramp.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/cusinolake ('There are vault toilets.' 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well.' 'Carry-in access is located at each campsite') + amenity table (boat access: C), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/cusinolake ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis.' 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay.') + amenity table ('Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com': no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 'Six sites for tent and small trailer use' (the DNR's standard state forest wording; no maximum length posted). One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/cusinolake ('There are six sites for tent and small trailer use'; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + amenity table (6 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic Michigan DNR state forest campground on 140-acre Cusino Lake (muskie, perch and largemouth bass), 24 miles northeast of Shingleton via H-15, H-58 and Ross Lake Road, Schoolcraft County, under 10 miles from Pictured Rocks. Every site is on the shore with direct water access. ORV and snowmobile riding allowed between the campground and nearby trails (Trail 8). --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 6 sites, $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day max (all confirmed; the 15-night max had been inherited). Season (open all year, roads not plowed) already manual and matches. Phone 906-341-2355 matches (Indian Lake SP). Note trimmed of field restatements.
